environment.description: Lambda function deployed with Function URL where AuthType is set to AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/OpsAutomationRole with condition StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID o-abc123def4. Callers must sign requests with SigV4 using credentials from the OpsAutomationRole (obtained via sts:AssumeRole which requires MFA). The Function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} for any request lacking a valid Authorization header with SigV4 signature. Note: the CORS headers in the Lambda response code are irrelevant because the Lambda runtime never executes for unauthenticated requests - the Function URL auth layer rejects before invocation. The code still contains the permissive CORS and lacks CSRF tokens, but browsers cannot generate valid SigV4 signatures from a cross-origin context.
